name: Caerulescent-Terminus
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws an orbital debris ring, patient as erosion itself.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in titanium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
